component.subject: Benediction
component.source: The Grace (2 Corinthians 13:14) as it closes Morning and Evening Prayer in the Book of Common Prayer (1662; American Standard Book of 1892); "Holy Ghost" rendered "Holy Spirit".

original.p: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Ghost, be with us all evermore. Amen.
